query: SELECT pc.id, pc.userId, pc.componentId, pc.status, u.name, u.email, c.code, c.name as compName FROM professor_components pc JOIN users u ON pc.userId = u.id JOIN components c ON pc.componentId = c.id WHERE pc.status = 'pending';
